data.name: Pramanand
data.gender_notes: Pramanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pramanam means proof, evidence, knowledge. Anand means joy, bliss. Therefore, Pramanand means one who is full of knowledge and joy. The name Pramanand carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pramanand usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, leading to inner peace and happiness.
data.etymology: Pramanand belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pramanand total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name signifies a deep connection to the pursuit of truth and knowledge, reflecting the importance of education and intellectual cultivation in Hindu society.

historical_references.reference: Pramanand was a renowned 13th century Hindu philosopher and scholar from the Bhagavat lineage of the Brahmin community in Gujarat, India. He is best known for his commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, the Srimad Bhagavad Gita-Bhusana.
historical_references.context: Medieval India, Bhagavat lineage, Hindu philosophy, Bhagavad Gita commentary

historical_references.reference: Pramanand was also a significant figure in the 16th century Hindu Bhakti movement in Maharashtra, India. He is known for his devotional poetry and hymns, especially his composition, the Prabodhana-Chandrodaya, which is considered a classic text in the Bhakti tradition.
historical_references.context: Late medieval India, Hindu Bhakti movement, devotional poetry, Bhagavad Gita commentary
